qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Cadence forms an indispensable duopoly with Synopsys controlling >75% of the electronic design automation (EDA) market. Moat barriers are practically insurmountable due to: (1) deep process design kit (PDK) integration with TSMC, Intel, and Samsung foundries; (2) decades of electrical engineering muscle memory; and (3) catastrophic tape-out failure risk (a botched $100M+ mask set prevents customers from ever switching for minor price concessions). Proof of moat: 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 47.7%, gross margins of ~89-90%, operating margins >30%, ~85% recurring subscription revenue, and 10-year Owner EPS CAGR of 13.8%. Primary erosion threats: tightening US-China export controls restricting tool access for Chinese fabless firms (~10-12% of revenue), hyperscaler customer consolidation, and antitrust scrutiny.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Unassailable mission-critical EDA duopolist serving as an essential toll booth on global semiconductor R&D and AI silicon design. Moat backed by deep foundry PDK certifications and extreme switching costs. Highly recurring software model (~85% ratable/subscription) with robust pricing power and net cash balance sheet ($3.0B cash vs $2.48B debt). [5-10Y g: semiconductor design & AI complexity volume 7.0% + EDA pricing/up-tiering 2.0% + multiphysics expansion 1.5% - R&D/cloud compute drag 0.5% + net share buybacks 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year operating history demonstrates elite compounding: FY2016-FY2025 revenue grew from $1.82B to $5.30B (12.6% CAGR), operating income expanded from $245M to $1.49B (22.2% CAGR), and Owner EPS rose from $0.92 to $4.37 (13.8% CAGR). GAAP ROIC consistently exceeds 40% (5-year median 47.7%; FY2025 48.3%), with operating tangible ROIC >100%. Free cash flow conversion is outstanding at 93.8% multi-year median (FY2025 OCF $1.73B vs capex $142M; reported FCF $1.59B exceeds GAAP net income of $1.11B by 143%). Net cash position of $521M ($3.00B cash & equivalents vs $2.48B long-term debt). Interest coverage is pristine at 12.8x EBIT/Interest. EDA software is insulated from agentic AI disruption, acting instead as a primary beneficiary as complex multi-die chiplet, 3D packaging, and custom AI accelerator design demand surge.
